title: Miami and Fort Lauderdale Private City Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This tour blends history, culture, art, and beachside beauty, giving you the best of both Miami, the "Magic City" and Ft. Lauderdale the "Venice of America".

Be enchanted by the bustling street life and the rich variety of cultures and people. Experience the beauty and the hidden treasures and visit the famous attractions as well as places only locals know.

From the Beaches to Downtown, from the Arts District to the Fashion District, From Ocean Drive to Las Olas Boulevard, Attractions and local hot spots, the modern sides of these metropolises and the historical places, you will see it all.

A fun and interesting tour, with time in between to sip your Cuban coffee in Little Havana, or to stroll along on Ocean Drive or on Ft. Lauderdale Beach.

Listen to the stories, and the history and there is a lot to see. Don't forget your camera!
